title: Persist text-free responses and resume interrupted model runs
description:
## Scope

Key successful responses by full state/question fingerprints plus model/version and transport-relevant configuration. Store run/dataset revision, condition, example IDs, ordering, draw, target manifest ID, structured raw answers, available probabilities, usage, latency, attempt outcome, and failure metadata. Never store source text or credentials; retry only eligible failures under the ceiling.

## Definition of done

Fake-client specs prove crashes/resumes reuse complete successful responses, changed examples/order/task/model invalidate cache hits, malformed responses remain identifiable, and secret sentinels never enter artifacts.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Persist text-free responses and resume interrupted model runs
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a run has cached successful responses and an interrupted attempt
    When the run resumes with the same matrix
    Then only missing or retryable cells are attempted and every attempt is counted
```

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-ce360969-5b44-554d-ba77-d4a38dbd7de1`.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented and reviewed atomic SQLite reservation/completion with immutable task/preflight/dataset/model provenance, stale-token rejection, strict response sanitization, and physical-versus-logical snapshots. Remaining acceptance work: connect the actual bounded collector and prove full crash/resume behavior through fake model integration. Story remains in progress.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Review finding: current native cell identity binds model/version and generic context-plan state/question hash, but transport-relevant configuration is not yet bound. Jev base_url and Kev endpoint changes must invalidate approved requests before claiming complete physical-request cache identity or running live collection. Keep this story in progress; no DSPy integration is authorized.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Native Jev workflow now binds explicit public transport fingerprints into protocol/model/cache identity, reserves attempts before factory construction, supports opt-in bounded retry/recovery, and verifies mixed cached/new provenance. Full offline suite passed 125 tests against the pinned core dependency, including complete development collection -> native cache-only optimizer replay -> scoreboard -> report. No DSPy, provider credentials, or live calls. Keep cross-provider collection/compatibility claims pending their separate adapter pilots and matrix work.
